title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode18 To See That View Once More

meta.Episode: Episode18 — To See That View Once More

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, are you still worried about Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I can't help thinking about her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of all the idols I know, I think Haruka felt the most responsibility and took the most pride in her work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means that her decision to quit would have been that much more painful for her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even I've had a hard time since I quit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know it was my own choice, but from waking up in the morning to going to sleep at night, I couldn't stop wondering whether I'd really made the right decision.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I couldn't even see how much I was worrying those around me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It was the same for me.
All I could think about was how painful things were.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At first, I tried to be positive and think about the fact I'd have more time to myself without having to worry about what others thought, but it was no good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I may have ended up an idol by accident, but somewhere along the way it became extremely important to me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So when I quit, it felt like I'd lost a part of myself. It was really hard.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wonder if Haruka feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wonder if there's anything we can do for her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know it's not our place to second guess a decision she struggled so hard to make, but still...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right. As fellow ex-idols, maybe there's something we can do for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Although I don't know what that might be...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...
Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: O-Oh, good morning, Minori. Why are you so out of breath?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going to need lots of stamina if I'm going to put on a show, so I ran 10km before practice!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What's with the sudden burst of enthusiasm?
You were so down yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, did you say show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going to put on a show for Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So that sea of blue glow sticks is a precious memory of Haruka's?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right. And I think I can show it to her again by putting on a show in that other world.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's why I decided to do this! Even if it only helps cheer her up a little...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that view is only really visible from up on stage, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, for her to see it, she'll have to be up there, which is the one thing she can't do. What are you going to do about that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And if it really is a precious memory from her time as an idol, seeing it may be hard for her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, I suppose that's true...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm here to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There are some things that are impossible no matter how hard you try.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Haruka no longer believes that tomorrow can be a better day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It must be so painful for her to not look forward to the future like that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If there's even a chance that it will help her move forward, I want her to see that view once more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That light comes from the feelings of all the people Haruka gave hope to! I'm sure it will reach her!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone's hope that Haruka can move forward, even if she's no longer an idol, will reach her!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm still thinking of a way to get her to come with me to the stage, but until I can, Haruka and I are both stuck in the present!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And if one show isn't enough to restore Haruka's faith, then I'll keep putting on shows until she's able to move on!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... So in other words, you don't have a plan. At all. But you've always been like that, haven't you? You're so rash and unreasonable.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You say that, but you've already decided to help, haven't you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess so. I can't really blame her for something like this after what I did at your agency.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, would you let us do this show with you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd love to help too.
We were just wondering what we could do to help cheer up Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm finally able to think positively again thanks to what Airi did for me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And since you're always thinking so much about Haruka, I believe that together, we might just be able to cheer her up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Besides, we can't very well call ourselves idols if we don't cheer on someone with as much tenacity as you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Momoi! Hinomori!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wonder how Minori and the others are doing. Maybe I should go and check in on them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure if we wait, they'll come visit soon. Oh, see! Here they come now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Miku! Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh! Airi and Shizuku are here too!
It's been a while! How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good. Thanks for everything, Rin.
It's thanks to you that I'm finally able to try again.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm so glad you're feeling better, Airi!
Idols really do look their best when they smile♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're right. Airi always seems so strange when she's feeling down.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Strange? Hey, even I get depressed sometimes, you know.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Miku! Rin! Guess what?!
Momoi and Hinomori have decided to join the show to help cheer up Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We dropped by to see how big the stage was in order to help with practice.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In that case, why don't you stay here to practice? What do you think, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! This world was created from your feelings, after all. As long as we're not putting on a show, feel free to practice here as much as you like!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? That would be a huge help, right Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you, Miku! Rin!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Stop! You're not moving your arms enough!
You keep doing that during the second half of the song!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Think about making sure your feelings can reach all the way to the people in the back! Let's try that again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your pitch keeps changing a bit as well. That tends to happen when you tense up, so make sure to pay attention to your breathing, especially when you're nervous.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you do that, your feelings will travel even further.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Slow down my breathing... Relax my shoulders...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! With Airi's and Shizuku's feelings working together like this, their performance is starting to shine brighter and brighter!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling this is going to be a great show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I did it! That one felt perfect all the way through to the end!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hold on. Let's check the recording to see.
Yeah, looks great. This should be good enough to perform for Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Well done, Minori.
I feel like we were setting the pace there toward the end, though. Sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it.
It's thanks to you two that I've come this far. Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All that's left is to reach Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Right!
